frictions.description: Direct URL navigation to /entities/:id/edit crashes with 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' React error. The EditEntityPage component has early returns for isError and isLoading states before useMemo/useCallback hooks, violating React's rules of hooks. Navigation from the entity detail page via the Edit button works correctly because the component tree is already warm.
frictions.resolution: Used entity detail page as entry point for all mutation tests, clicking the Edit button to navigate to the edit form. This works reliably.

frictions.description: Property IDs must be valid 32-char hex strings. The UI form does not validate property ID format, so submitting with non-hex property IDs causes the ingest server to return an error. This was discovered during initial entity creation attempts.
frictions.resolution: Used valid 32-char hex property IDs (e.g., 'cc11223344556677889900aabbccdde1') for all mutation tests.

frictions.description: The ingest server's createEntity endpoint does not support 'number' value type — only 'text' is supported. Attempting to use 'number' returns 'Unsupported value type: number'.
frictions.resolution: Used 'text' value type for all property tests instead of 'number'.

frictions.description: Mutation polling completes very quickly (~2-3 seconds including ingest + indexer processing), making it impossible to capture the spinner in a screenshot. The spinner state is confirmed by code review.
frictions.resolution: Confirmed spinner via code inspection (EntityForm renders 'Saving...' when isSubmitting=true) and observed during earlier tests.

summary: Tested 7 assertions (VAL-EDIT-001, 003-008): all passed. VAL-EDIT-002 was not assigned. Key findings: (1) Edit button correctly navigates to edit page. (2) Name changes send only changed NAME property in values array. (3) Property removal sends property ID in unset array. (4) New property addition sends property in values array. (5) No-op submit shows message and disables button. (6) Spinner appears during submission with navigation on success. (7) Error responses display error message and preserve form edits. Critical bug discovered: direct URL access to /entities/:id/edit crashes due to React hooks rules violation (early returns before useMemo/useCallback).
